title: A visual-language foundation model for pathology image analysis using medical Twitter

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A visual-language foundation model for pathology image analysis using medical Twitter》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The lack of annotated publicly available medical images is a major barrier for computational research and education innovations.

evidence.text: The lack of annotated publicly available medical images is a major barrier for computational research and education innovations.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A visual-language foundation model for pathology image analysis using medical Twitter》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】We demonstrate the value of this resource by developing pathology language-image pretraining (PLIP), a multimodal artificial intelligence with both image and text understanding, which is trained on OpenPath.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Training a simple supervised classifier on top of PLIP embeddings also achieves 2.5% improvement in F1 scores compared to using other supervised model embeddings.

evidence.text: We demonstrate the value of this resource by developing pathology language-image pretraining (PLIP), a multimodal artificial intelligence with both image and text understanding, which is trained on OpenPath.
Training a simple supervised classifier on top of PLIP embeddings also achieves 2.5% improvement in F1 scores compared to using other supervised model embeddings.
